Drupal CMS.PORT: Port of the image's Apache server, also used by Railway's health check.
Drupal CMS.DRUPAL_DATABASE_HOST: Private address of the PostgreSQL service.
Drupal CMS.DRUPAL_DATABASE_PORT: PostgreSQL port on the private network.
Drupal CMS.DRUPAL_DATABASE_NAME: Database that holds Drupal's content, configuration, users and sessions.
Drupal CMS.DRUPAL_DATABASE_PASSWORD: Password of the PostgreSQL user, referenced from the PostgreSQL service.
Drupal CMS.DRUPAL_HASH_SALT: Generated secret Drupal uses for one-time login links, form tokens and other hashes. Changing it invalidates them.
Drupal CMS.DRUPAL_ADMIN_USER: User name of the administrator account created on the first boot.
Drupal CMS.DRUPAL_ADMIN_EMAIL: Email of the administrator account and the site's sender address, set on the first boot. Use your own address.
Drupal CMS.DRUPAL_ADMIN_PASSWORD: Generated password of the administrator account, used only on the first boot. Change it in Drupal after signing in.
Drupal CMS.DRUPAL_SITE_NAME: Site name set on the first boot; change it later under Configuration > Basic site settings.

PostgreSQL.POSTGRES_DB: Database created on the first boot for Drupal.
PostgreSQL.POSTGRES_USER: PostgreSQL user created on the first boot.
PostgreSQL.POSTGRES_PASSWORD: Generated password of the PostgreSQL user, set on the first boot.
PostgreSQL.PGDATA: Data directory below the volume mount, away from the volume's lost+found.
